name: Huldah
overview: Huldah was a prophetess in Jerusalem who delivered a solemn message from the LORD concerning the impending judgment on the city due to the people's idolatry and rebellion. When King Josiah's officials sought her counsel, she confirmed that the words found in the newly discovered book foretold destruction upon Jerusalem and its inhabitants. Yet, she also conveyed God's mercy toward the king himself, recognizing his humility and repentance in response to the revelation. Huldah's role demonstrates God's use of faithful servants to communicate His righteous judgment and grace.
